image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a light-colored wooden bookcase filled with books and media cases. The bookcase features multiple horizontal shelves loaded with colorful spines. To the right, a vertical wooden support or adjacent shelving unit is visible, containing a few larger items including what appears to be a small electronic device or toy. The lighting is warm and indoor.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is illegible and distorted. While some blurring is expected due to resolution, many spines show nonsensical character shapes or melting letters typical of AI generation failing to render fine print accurately.
The vertical wooden divider on the right has a slightly warped, unnatural curve where it meets the horizontal shelf, lacking the rigid straightness expected of wood construction.
The spines of the books blend into each other slightly at the edges, lacking distinct separation gaps between individual books.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar furniture type like a display cabinet.
To verify the physical depth of the shelves and ensure books are properly grounded on them without floating or clipping.
To check for merging boundaries between adjacent books and verify the sharpness of the wooden frame edges.
To rigorously analyze the legibility of text on book spines, a common failure point in AI-generated images.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric straightness of wooden shelves and dividers
Physical contact points between books and shelves
Consistency of wood grain texture across surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings on book spines. Even if the classifier confirms 'bookcase', severe text gibberish is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, verify if the geometric depth auditor detects any 'floating' books that don't quite touch the shelf surface.
